I know many of you were frustrated by last year's rollout of the inventory software, so let me explain how this upgrade will be different. Welcome to the Hartley Art Museum, and thank you for joining this afternoon's tour. We'll spend about forty-five minutes in the east wing, which features paintings from the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries.
